utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still waiting on the broken items and names, and once we have that list we can get the repair drive moving. I’m also thinking Saturday morning around 10 a.m. could work if that suits everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — once the broken items and names are in, we can lock in Saturday at 10. I’ll keep an ear out for updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll send you over to the fence fix too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep repeating the plan and spreading the word about the repair drive. And I’ll head over to the fence fix too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Vik — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and point a few more neighbors your way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s still left to do on the repair drive? I can help with the fence if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Dane, no worries — we still need a couple hands on the fence and a few tools sorted out. If you’re up for it, I can bring my toolbox over and we’ll knock it out together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Gus — bring the toolbox and I’ll meet you by the fence. I can help sort the tools first, then we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you bring any extra tools and a roll of tape? I'll point you to the fence fix first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ve got tape, and I’ll bring any extra tools I can find. Just point me to the fence fix first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren. Head over to the fence by the north side, and I’ll show you where to start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking one more time — you’re really coming to the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I’m still coming to the repair drive this weekend. If you can bring the tools and any spare screws, I’ll sort through them when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — I’ll bring the tools and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo, I’m still trying to keep it aligned with the school schedule—do we have a time set for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’m checking what we’ve got and finishing the missing-supplies list. Once that’s ready, I’ll bring it over so we can set a time that fits the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo—that works for me. Just bring the list over when it’s ready, and we can pick a time that fits the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking in—did you find the exact room for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still on my way to the community center to check the exact room. I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — just send me the room when you find it, and I’ll keep the urgent list ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but we still need a clear start time and a quick list of what’s missing. Let me know once that’s settled so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by soon and pass along any houses that need help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo. Please make sure you bring the start time and that missing list too, so I can plan the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m in—I’ll be there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks for confirming — I’ll stop by and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. See you there for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. Once that’s set, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I can help make that list. Who’s already signed up for which jobs?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit out of the loop, so I should check what’s new and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s alright—just let me know when you’ve checked. We’re still planning to go ahead this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I’ll check what’s new and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for real—go ahead and tell people the repair drive is on!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s on Sunday at the community center now, and I’ll keep the list updated if any more homes are added.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks for the update — I’ll pass along that it’s Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve nearly finished the list for the repair drive, Vik — I’ll bring over the missing items as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Cleo — bring it over when you’re ready and I’ll keep everyone posted about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll finish up the list and bring it by shortly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind too, but I know Cleo was putting together a list of what still needs to be gathered. I should check what’s new and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — thanks. I’ll wait for your update once you’ve checked with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check with Cleo and see what’s still needed, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Sam — bring the toolbox and we’ll tackle what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Leo — that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. Once that’s set, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can handle making the list of broken items and assigning jobs—just send me what’s already known.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m still coming by the repair drive. I’ll stop in and see what needs doing, and Gus can bring the toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — that sounds good. If you can, please bring any spare screws too, and I’ll sort through everything when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll bring any spare screws I’ve got and stop by to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 10 could work, but I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with the school schedule. If that time is still okay, let me know and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday at 10 works for me. Just let me know if the school schedule changes, and I’ll keep the urgent list ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Mina — I’ll keep it at 10 for now and double-check the school schedule just in case. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m late—what’s still left to do on the repair drive? I can help with the fence if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the repair drive is still at the community center—want me to check the exact room? If you can help with the fence, I’ll point you that way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please—point me to the right room, and I’ll head over to help with the fence.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Kira — I can bring my toolbox over and help sort out what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking one more time — you’re really coming to the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I’m coming — I’ll bring my toolbox over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll send you over to the fence fix.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — I’ll head over to the fence fix and help point people that way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and if I hear anyone asking, I’ll send them your way too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep an eye on the list for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Sunday at the community center works — I’ll keep telling folks and send them your way for the list updates.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you spreading the word and sending people my way for updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—thanks for reminding me. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — if you can help at the community center on Sunday, that’d be great. I’ll send you the updated list so you know where we need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Rosa—Sunday at the community center works for me. Send over the updated list and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. If you can help spread the word and maybe bring any spare screws or basic tools, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can spread the word and I’ll see what tools I’ve got. I’ll bring any spare screws I can find too.
